distinct_from.distinction: REVERSELF-0001 observes, compares, refuses, and preserves evidence boundaries; MATTER-0001 compiles structural Matter. Neither identity subsumes the other.

semantic.definition: A bounded, non-mutating memory-boundary Matter that scans claims, compares externally observed bytes to receipts, and records refusal/quarantine evidence without repairing state.

invariants: Reading and hashing do not grant authority or mutate targets.
A receipt records observed bytes but does not authorize future writes.
A digest mismatch preserves the expected digest and quarantines without repair.
A stale admission is refused against a new preimage.
Same-runtime or same-identity channel agreement is not independent witnessing.
Scanner findings and historical ambiguity are preserved without rewriting source evidence.
REVERSELF-0001 does not set REALISELF or the migration gate.

transitions.condition: Every configured committed JSON input matches the selected source commit.
Exact externally returned bytes are compared to the unchanged receipt digest.
A mismatch is recorded; no repair is performed.
A stale decision is rejected and any new operation uses current-preimage admission.
No distinct independently authenticated witness endpoint is available.
Terminal proof records all reachable results and exact unresolved boundaries.

receipt.note: This Matter defines evidence operations; it does not receipt or admit MORPH-015.
